title: Help us improve Boardsesh?
body: Allow product analytics and optional session replay to help us see what works. No thanks keeps these off. Basic crash and performance diagnostics stay on. Your choice applies wherever you are signed in, and you can change it anytime.
settingsBody: Choose whether to share product analytics and optional session replay. Basic diagnostics stay on. You can keep climbing with either choice.
syncError: Your choice is saved here. We will sync it to your account when you are back online.
